# Dados
```{ojs}
//|output: false

rawdata = FileAttachment("/data/resultados_distritos.json").json()
// console.log(data)

raw_data_partidos = FileAttachment("/data/resultados_partidos.json").json()

data = rawdata.map((d) => ({
    ...d,
    vencedor: Object.keys(d).filter(k => isPartido(k))
    .filter(k => typeof d[k] === 'number')
    .reduce((a,b) => d[a] > d[b] ? a : b)    
}))

data_partidos = raw_data_partidos.map((d) => ({
    ...d,
    Total: Object.values(d).filter(k => typeof k ==='number').reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0)
}))

function partidoRow(partido){
    return data_partidos.find(p => p.Partido === partido) || null;
}

// console.log(data_partidos)

function isPartido(key) {
    if(key == "ADN" || key == "B.E."
        || key == "CH" || key == "E"
        || key == "L" || key == "NC"
        || key == "ND" || key == "PAN"
        || key == "PLS" || key == "PPD/PSD.CDS-PP"
        || key == "PPM" || key == "PS"
        || key == "R.I.R." || key == "VP"
        || key == "PCP-PEV" || key == "PCTP/MRPP"
        || key == "IL" || key == "JPP") return true
    else return false
}

function getPartyColors() {
  return {
    PS: "#ff0000",
    "PPD/PSD.CDS-PP": "#ff9900",
    CH: "#0000ff",
    IL: "#00ffff",
    "B.E.": "#ff00ff",
    "PCP-PEV": "#008000",
    L: "#800080",
    PAN: "#00ff00",
  };
}

```

### Row {height="100%"}

```{ojs}
//|output: false

inscritosRow = partidoRow("Inscritos")
votantesRow = partidoRow("Votantes")
// 1. Taxa de Abstenção Nacional
abstencao = 100 - (votantesRow.Total / inscritosRow.Total * 100);
// console.log(abstencao)

// 2. Distrito com Menor Abstenção
function encontrarMenorAbstencao() {
    let menorTaxa = 100;
    let distritoMenor = "";

    for (const [distrito, inscritos] of Object.entries(inscritosRow)) {
        if (distrito !== "Total") {
            const taxa = 100 - (votantesRow[distrito] / inscritos * 100);
            if (taxa < menorTaxa) {
                menorTaxa = taxa;
                distritoMenor = distrito;
            }
        }
    }
    return distritoMenor;
}

partidoVencedor = data_partidos.filter(d => isPartido(d.Partido)).sort((a, b) => b.Total - a.Total)[0]
// console.log(partidoVencedor)
```

```{ojs}
coresPartidos = getPartyColors();
mapDiv = html`<div style="height: 80vh;"> </div>`

mutable selectedDistrito = data.find(d => d.Distrito === "Lisboa")


{
const map = L.map(mapDiv, {
    zoomControl: true,
    dragging: true,
    scrollWheelZoom: false
});

L.tileLayer('https://{s}.tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png').addTo(map);

const distritos = L.geoJSON(mergedmap, {

    style: (feat) => {
        return{
            color: "#4b4b4bff",
            fillColor: getPartyColors()[feat.properties.vencedor],
            weight: 1,
            fillOpacity: 0.2
        }
    },
    onEachFeature: (feat, layer) => {
        layer.bindTooltip(
            `<div>
            <strong>${feat.properties.Distrito}</strong><br/>
            <span style="color:${coresPartidos[feat.properties.vencedor]}; font-weight: 400;">${feat.properties.vencedor}</span>
            </div>`, { sticky: true });

        layer.on("click", () => { mutable selectedDistrito = feat.properties })

        layer.on("mouseover", () => layer.setStyle({weight: 2, fillOpacity: 0.35}));
        layer.on("mouseout", () => layer.setStyle({weight: 1, fillOpacity: 0.2}));
    }
}).addTo(map);

map.fitBounds(distritos.getBounds());
map.setZoom(7);

return mapDiv
}
```

```{ojs}
//|output: false

partidoLinha = data_partidos.find(d => d.Partido === selectedPartido);
// console.log(partidoLinha)

function partidoRowToArray(row) {
  if (!row) return [];

  const entries = Object.entries(row)
    .filter(([k, v]) =>
      k !== "Partido" &&
      k !== "Total" &&
      typeof v === "number"
    )
    .map(([Distrito, votos]) => ({ Distrito, votos }));

  const total = d3.sum(entries, d => d.votos);

  return entries.map(d => ({
    Distrito: d.Distrito,
    Votos: total > 0 ? d.votos / total : 0
  }));
}

partidoSelecionadoPlot = partidoRowToArray(partidoLinha)

```


### Row {height="100%"}

```{ojs}
//|output: true


// O seguinte código foi retirado e adaptado a partir da página da observablehq
// https://observablehq.com/@d3/horizontal-bar-chart/2

chartBars = {
  // Specify the chart’s dimensions, based on a bar’s height.
  const barHeight = 60;
  const marginTop = 30;
  const marginRight = 120;
  const marginBottom = 10;
  const marginLeft = 160;
  const width = 928;
  const height = Math.ceil((partidoSelecionadoPlot.length + 0.1) * barHeight) + marginTop + marginBottom;

  // Create the scales.
  const x = d3.scaleLinear()
      .domain([0, d3.max(partidoSelecionadoPlot, d => d.Votos)])
      .range([marginLeft, width - marginRight]);
  
  const y = d3.scaleBand()
      .domain(d3.sort(partidoSelecionadoPlot, d => -d.Votos).map(d => d.Distrito))
      .rangeRound([marginTop, height - marginBottom])
      .padding(0.1);

  // Create a value format.
  const format = x.tickFormat(20, ".1%");

  // Create the SVG container.
  const svg = d3.create("svg")
      .attr("width", width)
      .attr("height", height)
      .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
      .attr("style", "max-width: 100%; height: auto; font: 20px sans-serif;");
  
  // Append a rect for each Distrito.
  svg.append("g")
      .attr("fill", "steelblue")
    .selectAll()
    .data(partidoSelecionadoPlot)
    .join("rect")
      .attr("x", x(0))
      .attr("y", (d) => y(d.Distrito))
      .attr("width", (d) => x(d.Votos) - x(0))
      .attr("height", y.bandwidth());
  
  // Append a label for each Distrito.
  svg.append("g")
      .attr("fill", "white")
      .attr("text-anchor", "end")
    .selectAll()
    .data(partidoSelecionadoPlot)
    .join("text")
      .attr("x", (d) => x(d.Votos))
      .attr("y", (d) => y(d.Distrito) + y.bandwidth() / 2)
      .attr("dy", "0.35em")
      .attr("dx", -4)
      .attr("font-size", "20px")
      .text((d) => format(d.Votos))
    .call((text) => text.filter(d => x(d.Votos) - x(0) < 20) // short bars
      .attr("dx", +4)
      .attr("fill", "black")
      .attr("text-anchor", "start"));

  // Create the axes.
  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(0,${marginTop})`)
      .call(d3.axisTop(x).ticks(width / 160, "%"))
      .call(g => g.select(".domain").remove())
      .call(g => g.selectAll("text").attr("font-size", "20px"));

  svg.append("g")
      .attr("transform", `translate(${marginLeft},0)`)
      .call(d3.axisLeft(y).tickSizeOuter(0))
      .call(g => g.selectAll("text").attr("font-size", "16px"));

  return svg.node();
}
```

# Resultados por Partido (Sunburst)

```{ojs}
//|output: false

// Funcão adaptada da versão disponibilizada pelos docentes
function convertByParty() {
    const root = { name: "Partidos", children: [] };

    data_partidos.forEach(partido => {
        const nomePartido =  partido.Partido

        const children = Object.entries(partido).filter(([k, v]) => k !== "Partido" && typeof v === "number" && k !== "Total"); 

        if (!isPartido(nomePartido)) return;


        root.children.push({
            name: nomePartido,
            children: children.map(([distrito, votos]) => ({name: distrito, value: votos}))
        });
    });
return root;
}

eleicoesHier = convertByParty()
console.log(eleicoesHier)
```

## Column {height= "40%"}

```{ojs}
//|title: Gráfico Circular "Sunburst"

// O seguinte código foi retirado e adaptado a partir da página da observablehq
// https://observablehq.com/@d3/zoomable-sunburst

chart = {
  // Specify the chart’s dimensions.
  const width = 900;
  const radius = width / 6;

  // Create the color scale.
  const color = d3.scaleOrdinal(d3.quantize(d3.interpolateRainbow, eleicoesHier.children.length + 1));

  // Compute the layout.
  const hierarchy = d3.hierarchy(eleicoesHier)
      .sum(d => d.value)
      .sort((a, b) => b.value - a.value);
  const root = d3.partition()
      .size([2 * Math.PI, hierarchy.height + 1])
    (hierarchy);
  root.each(d => d.current = d);

  // Create the arc generator.
  const arc = d3.arc()
      .startAngle(d => d.x0)
      .endAngle(d => d.x1)
      .padAngle(d => Math.min((d.x1 - d.x0) / 2, 0.005))
      .padRadius(radius * 1.5)
      .innerRadius(d => d.y0 * radius)
      .outerRadius(d => Math.max(d.y0 * radius, d.y1 * radius - 1))

  // Create the SVG container.
  const svg = d3.create("svg")
      .attr("viewBox", [-width / 2, -width / 2, width, width])
      .style("max-height", "100%").style("width", "auto")
      .style("font", "14px sans-serif");

  // Append the arcs.
  const path = svg.append("g")
    .selectAll("path")
    .data(root.descendants().slice(1))
    .join("path")
      .attr("fill", d => {
        // subir até ao nó do partido
        let p = d;
        while (p.depth > 1) p = p.parent;
        // p.data.name é o nome do partido
        return getPartyColors()[p.data.name] ?? "#f1adadff";
        })
      .attr("fill-opacity", d => arcVisible(d.current) ? (d.children ? 0.6 : 0.4) : 0)
      .attr("pointer-events", d => arcVisible(d.current) ? "auto" : "none")
      .attr("d", d => arc(d.current));

  // Make them clickable if they have children.
  path.filter(d => d.children)
      .style("cursor", "pointer")
      .on("click", clicked);

  const format = d3.format(",d");
  path.append("title")
      .text(d => `${d.ancestors().map(d => d.data.name).reverse().join("/")}\n${format(d.value)}`);

  const label = svg.append("g")
      .attr("pointer-events", "none")
      .attr("text-anchor", "middle")
      .style("user-select", "none")
    .selectAll("text")
    .data(root.descendants().slice(1))
    .join("text")
      .attr("dy", "0.35em")
      .attr("fill-opacity", d => +labelVisible(d.current))
      .attr("transform", d => labelTransform(d.current))
      .text(d => d.data.name);

  const parent = svg.append("circle")
      .datum(root)
      .attr("r", radius)
      .attr("fill", "none")
      .attr("pointer-events", "all")
      .on("click", clicked);

    const cornerLabel = svg.append("text")
        .attr("text-anchor", "middle")
        .attr("dy", "0.35em")
        .style("font", "18px sans-serif")
        .style("font-weight", 600)
        .style("opacity", 0.2)
        .text(root.data.name);

  // Handle zoom on click.
  function clicked(event, p) {
    cornerLabel.text(p.data.name);
    parent.datum(p.parent || root);

    root.each(d => d.target = {
      x0: Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (d.x0 - p.x0) / (p.x1 - p.x0))) * 2 * Math.PI,
      x1: Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (d.x1 - p.x0) / (p.x1 - p.x0))) * 2 * Math.PI,
      y0: Math.max(0, d.y0 - p.depth),
      y1: Math.max(0, d.y1 - p.depth)
    });

    const t = svg.transition().duration(event.altKey ? 7500 : 750);

    // Transition the data on all arcs, even the ones that aren’t visible,
    // so that if this transition is interrupted, entering arcs will start
    // the next transition from the desired position.
    path.transition(t)
        .tween("data", d => {
          const i = d3.interpolate(d.current, d.target);
          return t => d.current = i(t);
        })
      .filter(function(d) {
        return +this.getAttribute("fill-opacity") || arcVisible(d.target);
      })
        .attr("fill-opacity", d => arcVisible(d.target) ? (d.children ? 0.6 : 0.4) : 0)
        .attr("pointer-events", d => arcVisible(d.target) ? "auto" : "none") 

        .attrTween("d", d => () => arc(d.current));

    label.filter(function(d) {
        return +this.getAttribute("fill-opacity") || labelVisible(d.target);
      }).transition(t)
        .attr("fill-opacity", d => +labelVisible(d.target))
        .attrTween("transform", d => () => labelTransform(d.current));
  }
  
  function arcVisible(d) {
    return d.y1 <= 3 && d.y0 >= 1 && d.x1 > d.x0;
  }

  function labelVisible(d) {
    return d.y1 <= 3 && d.y0 >= 1 && (d.y1 - d.y0) * (d.x1 - d.x0) > 0.03;
  }

  function labelTransform(d) {
    const x = (d.x0 + d.x1) / 2 * 180 / Math.PI;
    const y = (d.y0 + d.y1) / 2 * radius;
    return `rotate(${x - 90}) translate(${y},0) rotate(${x < 180 ? 0 : 180})`;
  }

return html`
  <div style="height: 80vh; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;">
    ${svg.node()}
  </div>
`;
}

```

```{ojs}
        var dist = feature.properties.Distrito.toLowerCase().trim().split(' ');
```
